project.title: DNA extraction comparison testing 2019-2020
project.description: Our DNA extraction protocol is years old, and we want to compare new extraction methods to address outstanding issues. For more details, check out the motivation and experimental design here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1qbuySJLEpxQjql-P6kJOk8QOS7Uo3MS1CL3QT56sDXI/edit?usp=sharing
project.center_name: University of California San Diego Microbiome Initiative
